waystation.name: The Waystation

wayfarer.beforeCrossing: Wayfarer: The old bridge is gone. Look for the path around the chasm.
wayfarer.afterCrossing: Wayfarer: The stones remember the light. Safe travels.

waystation.objective: Follow the path up to Hollow Arch.

gate.opening: A gate shifts above the sentinel. The passage along the north wall is open.

sentinel.label: Sentinel
sentinel.name: Stone Sentinel
sentinel.tooDangerous: Too dangerous. Return to the rest point before trying again.
sentinel.defeated: The sentinel falls. The upper passage is clear.

lamp.label: Wayfarer’s Lamp
lamp.acquired: The lamp reveals the old paths. Look for matching marks.

bridge.beforeLamp: A lamp is carved into the stone. A faint mark answers across the gap.
bridge.revealed: A bridge of stone appears in the lamplight.
bridge.crossed: Shortcut opened. Return to the waystation when you are ready.

objectives.findPath: Find a way around the broken bridge.
objectives.returnWithLamp: Take the lamp back to the marked bridge.
objectives.complete: The path through Hollow Arch is open.
